title: O001-S1 Nonlinear Model-Class Sensitivity
purpose: Test whether the primary O001 no-increment result is an artifact of Ridge regression under the same features, windows, subject-held-out split, and strong baseline.
combined_features: 160 frozen EEG relative-band features reduced to PCA20 inside training fold
preprocessing: Fit only on each outer training set: one-hot categorical controls, median imputation, standardization, PCA20 for EEG.

decision.NONLINEAR_INCREMENT: At least one learner/axis has delta 95% CI strictly above zero.
decision.ROBUST_NO_INCREMENT: No learner/axis has delta 95% CI strictly above zero.
decision.STRONG_DEGRADATION: All learner/axis delta 95% CIs strictly below zero.

firewall: Sensitivity only; it cannot replace or redefine the frozen O001 primary endpoint. No feature/window changes.
